source.title: A Broken Ritual
source.description: This prestine scapula is all too recognizable -- Hakkar was summoned into the physical world and defeated. The trolls on Yojamba Island will want to hear more about what happened inside of Sunken Temple.
source.objective: Bring the Scapula of the Fallen Avatar to Molthor in Yojamba Isle.
source.progress: <name>, what news do you have from the Temple of Atal'Hakkar?
source.completion:
It can't be... the rumors of the Temple of the Atal'Hakkar are true?

Your victory inside of da Sunken Temple will be remembered by da Zandalari for a long time, mon. This bone.. it be an odd choice to deliver us.. but no doubt was one used to summon Hakkar into da physical world -- it will be in good hands now, <name>. We no longer have to worry about Hakkar coming back thanks to your efforts, mon... right?
